images.caption:
General plan of Holzminden PoW camp, 1917-18. South-east is to the top. 
Additional key:
Z = point of egress Medlicott-Walter escape. 
F = officers' entrance B house. 
E = orderlies' entrance B house.
D = postern gate. 

Q = original point of egress of tunnel. Later blind alley.

images.caption:
"The Mess": prisoners in Holzminden prisoner-of-war camp, c.1918.
Standing: Lt Norman A. Birks, Royal Flying Corps; Lt George C. Haldane, Argyll & Sutherland Highlanders; Lt Brian Manning, Irish Guards.
Seated: Capt F. Griffith, Lancashire Fusiliers; Lt Aubrey de Sélincourt, Royal Flying Corps.

Seated on ground: 2nd Lt Erroll Suvo Chunder Sen, Royal Flying Corps.
